STANDARD OF PERFORMANCE

To be an employee of this company, you must agree to our terms and conditions and commit to it wholeheartedly. Here are the following standards.

I will not focus on outcomes which lie outside my control. I will focus on my inputs, disciplines, attitudes and activities, which I can control and doing so I will more often find the outcomes I desire.

I will treat every team member, prospect and client with respect.

I will be MORE accountable to myself than anyone else.

I welcome outside accountability.

I am a prompt and punctual individual. I will show up to meetings on time with my camera on, unless previously communicated or I am serving another client/prospect.

I am a business professional. I will treat this business as if it were my own.

I am humble. I am confident in my value and abilities however, I take inventory of my deficiencies and aim to learn, grow and turn those weaknesses into strengths.

I'm not an individual. I'm a part of a team. When I win my team wins and when my team wins I win.

I will not complain to my co-workers about my job when it gets tough. Those conversations belong with my manager where we'll find a solution.

Being a sales rep is fun. I will not take myself too seriously and I will aim to create a balance between fun and excellence in my role.

By signing below, I confirm that I have completed all six modules of the onboarding course, understand the expectations of my role, and commit to upholding this Standard of Performance.
